important_instructions: The posts are purely temporary and co-terminable with the project. The selected candidate will have no claim to a regular appointment in ICMR-NITHR, Jabalpur, ICMR or any organization of the Govt. of India. The posts are contractual for the duration offered and may or may not be renewed, depending on satisfactory performance and requirement. The stipend or consolidated emoluments of the project positions may vary from time to time. Leave will be as per the ICMR policy for project staff. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview in person or for joining the post. Candidates must arrange their own transport and accommodation. Selected candidates must produce original documents of their qualification, age and experience before joining. If they are not found entitled, their selection will be cancelled immediately. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. Submitting wrong or false information will disqualify the candidature at any stage. The Director, ICMR-NITHR, Jabalpur reserves the right to consider or reject any application or candidature, and to cancel or modify the recruitment process at any time. The Director decides any matter not covered by the notice, and that decision is final and binding. Any addendum or corrigendum will not be published in newspapers. It will appear only on the institute website (www.nirth.res.in). Contact details printed in the notice: Tel: +91-761-2370800, email [email protected].

rows.post_s: Project Nurse-IV & Project Nurse-III, Project Field Officer, Project Assistant Multipurpose (Admin)

rows.category: Departmental candidates, or candidates who work or have worked on projects of ICMR Institutes/Centres
rows.relaxation: Up to a maximum of five years, or the completed months/years of earlier project service, whichever is less, as per ICMR guidelines. They must still meet the essential qualification and experience for the post.

rows.work_responsibility: NGS & Bioinformatics analysis, Team supervision, Research work related to public health, establishment of laboratory, Biosafety, Serological molecular Diagnostic and microbial pathogen and quality control, Documentation and other related works assigned by the P.I.
To develop and monitor the various research project, data analysis, manuscript writing and co-ordination with the state nodal officer and link medical college. Any other work assigned by the PI.

rows.post: Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical), drone and telemedicine project
rows.work_responsibility: To assist in implementing and running the i-DRONE Project under the National Health Research Programme (NHRP) in Balaghat District, Madhya Pradesh, particularly in remote, tribal and difficult-to-access terrains. To undertake field-based data collection, curation, validation and analysis related to drone-enabled healthcare logistics and the timely delivery of essential medical supplies to underserved areas. To assist in assessing field sites and to coordinate with healthcare facilities, stakeholders and State and District health authorities. To support the documentation of field activities, progress reports, data summaries and draft research articles under the Principal Investigator/Project Investigator. Any duties assigned by the Competent Authority.
Ph.D with experience in cloning, expression and purification of proteins & to conduct lab and field related activities and performance of Elisa/ Luminax assay and as per order of PI.

To supervise and coordinate project activities in the field to undertake follow-up, clinical data collection, curation, and monitoring of SCD patients as per the study protocol. To assist in data management, preparation of progress reports, and drafting of research articles under the guidance of the Principal Investigator. Any duties assigned by the Competent Authority.
Supervise and coordinate the activities of field teams. Monitor data quality, completeness, and adherence to the study protocol. Participant follow-up and any work assigned by the PI.
Conduct participant recruitment, informed consent, and baseline and follow-up assessments and any work assigned by the PI.

Field visits and project activities at designated sites. Field surveys, interviews, community interactions and data collection as per the approved protocol. Coordination with participants, local authorities, health facilities and other stakeholders. Field records, registers, consent/documentation and daily activity reports. Data entry, verification, compilation and preliminary analysis of field data. Logistics for field activities, meetings and awareness programmes. Any other project-related duties assigned by the Project Investigator.

rows.post: Project Technical Support-III, sickle cell hydroxyurea trial
rows.work_responsibility: To undertake project activities in the field. To undertake data collection, curation and follow-up of SCD patients. To assist in preparation of reports/ research articles as guided. Other duties assigned by the Competent Authority.

Work related to antigenic characterization of virus, working in the Pathophysiology/ immunobiology of dengue viral disease, virus and/or cell culture, animal models and patients' samples collection and other any works assigned by the P.I.
To conduct the field based health survey, data monitoring and analysis.
To assist in the office administration, record keeping, salary preparation, procurement and other office related work. To assist research staff & PI in the field/Office.
To conduct the field based health survey, blood collection, laboratory investigations such as CBC, Biochemistry etc.

Blood collection and laboratory investigations. Field surveys and data collection. Work related to different diseases of public health importance. Any other related work assigned by the Principal Investigator (PI).

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The application, filled in using the format given on the ICMR-NITHR website (www.nirth.res.in) and the ICMR, New Delhi website (www.main.icmr.nic.in) Copies of certificates, attached to the application Your complete address with Pin Code, Mobile number and E-mail ID, written in the application Details of two responsible persons from your locality, or two references who know you Download the application format from www.nirth.res.in or www.main.icmr.nic.in. Fill in the application in full, with your complete address with Pin Code, Mobile number, E-mail ID and two references. Attach copies of your certificates. Bring the application to ICMR-NITHR, Jabalpur (M.P) on the walk-in date for your post. Submit it at the venue between 9 AM and 11 AM.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: ICMR-NITHR accepts applications at the venue from 9 AM to 11 AM only, and candidates are not allowed to enter after 11 AM. Late, delayed or incomplete applications will be rejected without any intimation. Only eligible candidates will be allowed to take the interview, and appointments follow the recommendations of the selection committee. Results and any changes will be posted on the institute's website.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ICMR-NITHR walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The ICMR-NITHR walk-in interview is on 5 November 2026 for Project Research Scientist-II, Project Research Scientist-I, Consultant (Medical), Project Nurse-IV and Project Nurse-III. It is on 6 November 2026 for Project Field Officer, Project Technical Support-III, Project Assistant Multipurpose (Admin), Project Technical Support-II and Project Lab Technician-2.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the ICMR-NITHR walk-in?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted between 9 AM and 11 AM only, and nobody is allowed into the venue after 11 AM. The venue is ICMR-National Institute for Tribal Health Research, Nagpur Road, Post Garha, Jabalpur Pin-482003.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in ICMR-NITHR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 25 vacancies across 14 project positions under Advt. No.- 06/2026-27. Project Nurse-III has the most posts, with 10, followed by 2 each for Project Nurse-IV and Project Technical Support-II.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for ICMR-NITHR Project Nurse-III?
faq.answer: The essential qualification for Project Nurse-III is a Four year Nursing course. Experience in clinical assessments, participant interviews, field-based data collection and NCD Screening is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ICMR-NITHR project posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years for Project Research Scientist-II, 35 years for Project Research Scientist-I, Project Nurse-IV, Project Field Officer and Project Technical Support-III, and 30 years for Project Nurse-III, Project Assistant Multipurpose (Admin), Project Technical Support-II and Project Lab Technician-2. Consultant (Medical) must not exceed 70 years. Age is counted as on the date of the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary in ICMR-NITHR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary ranges from Rs. 20,000/- for Project Technical Support-II and Project Lab Technician-2 up to 67000/- for Project Research Scientist-II. Consultant (Medical) gets Rs. 64,000/- p.m. and Project Field Officer gets 28933/- p.m.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the ICMR-NITHR salary?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA is added to the consolidated salary for most posts. It is 20% for some posts and "as admissible" for others. The notice lists no HRA for Consultant (Medical) (Rs. 64,000/- p.m.) or Project Field Officer (28933/- p.m.).

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the ICMR-NITHR walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring the filled application in the format from www.nirth.res.in or www.main.icmr.nic.in, with copies of your certificates attached. The application must include your full address with Pin Code, mobile number, e-mail ID and details of two references.

faq.question: Q9. How is the selection made in ICMR-NITHR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is by walk-in interview. Only eligible candidates are allowed to take the interview, and appointments follow the selection committee's recommendations. Preference goes to local candidates and those with higher qualification and work experience.

faq.question: Q10. Is the ICMR-NITHR project job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are temporary and contractual, for three months or until the Manpower Outsourcing GeM Contract is finalised, whichever is earlier, and are co-terminable with the project. Selected candidates have no claim to a regular appointment in ICMR-NITHR or ICMR.
